title: ProjectE independent verification contract (input)
description: The project-specific contract that scripts/independent_verify.py measures a board against. This file replaces the archived tool's contract source, which was a Markdown table inside the project DOCS tree ('DOCS/02_Stackup_and_Impedance.md' section 3 plus 'DOCS/katman_kontrati.json'). Parsing prose tables meant a reformatted heading silently emptied the contract and every check degraded to NO_COVERAGE; the contract now lives in one machine-checkable file whose shape is pinned here.

default_skew_tolerance_mm.description: Applied to any net entry that does not set skew_tolerance_mm. There is no built-in default value: an unstated tolerance is not invented.

name.description: Differential pair base name (without the P/N suffix) or a single net name.

target_width_mm.description: Omit when the contract does not state a width; the width check is then skipped rather than measured against a guess.

allowed_layers.description: When present, any segment or arc of this net on another layer is a leak. Vias are exempt: changing layer is what a via is for.
